$comment: Advisories accepted by scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Each needs a reason and an expiry date; after that date CI fails again until someone re-checks the advisory.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS that needs an attacker-controlled glob pattern. Here picomatch only runs at build time inside ESLint and Vite, on patterns written in this repository. It is not in the shipped app (the production-only audit reports 0). No patched release exists yet (every version up to 4.0.7 is affected).
